stages.name: decorator_names
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "decorator",NULL AS "node","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,fn,decorator,node) AS (
        SELECT f.__path,f.id,d.id,x.id FROM declarations f JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=f.__path AND wrapper.id=f.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=wrapper.__path AND d.parent=wrapper.id AND d.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=d.__path AND x.parent=d.id
        UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,c.callee_id FROM walk w JOIN calls c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.id=w.node)
        SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,w.node,coalesce(a.attr,n.text) name FROM walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('identifier','attribute'))

stages.name: function_info
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind","line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "condition_id",NULL AS "condition_start",NULL AS "condition_end","condition_kind","alias_id","alias_source","module_name_id","module_name_source","name","region_start","qualname","lexical_parent","symbol","serverplan","function_cls" FROM (SELECT f.*,replace(substr(f.__path,1,length(f.__path)-3),'/','.')||'.'||f.qualname symbol,rx_matches(f.__path,'^(?:impl/common/l2070_server_plan/|impl/common/l7300_sql_versioned_transactions/|l2050_transaction/|l2055_lazy_result/|l2070_batching/|l5100_fts/|l5200_vector_index/|l7200_versioned_transactions/)') serverplan,own.cls function_cls FROM declaration_contexts f JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=f.__path AND own.id=f.id WHERE f.kind='function_definition')

stages.name: nested_regions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","kind" FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,kind FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('lambda','class_definition'))

stages.name: body_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind","arguments_id","arguments_start","arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "condition_id",NULL AS "condition_start",NULL AS "condition_end","condition_kind","alias_id","alias_source","module_name_id","module_name_source","callee_id","callee_kind","full_callee","callee","receiver","fn","symbol","serverplan" FROM (SELECT c.*,f.id fn,f.symbol,f.serverplan FROM calls c JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=c.__path AND o.id=c.id JOIN function_info f ON f.__path=o.__path AND f.id=o.fn AND o.cls IS f.function_cls WHERE c.__start>=f.body_start AND c.__end<=f.body_end AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nested_regions l WHERE l.__path=c.__path AND l.kind='lambda' AND l.__start<c.__start AND l.__end>=c.__end))

stages.name: body_attributes
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "condition_id",NULL AS "condition_start",NULL AS "condition_end",NULL AS "condition_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_source","attr",NULL AS "object","object_text","fn","serverplan" FROM (SELECT a.*,f.id fn,f.serverplan FROM attributes a JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=a.__path AND o.id=a.id JOIN function_info f ON f.__path=o.__path AND f.id=o.fn WHERE a.__start>=f.body_start AND a.__end<=f.body_end AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nested_regions l WHERE l.__path=a.__path AND l.kind IN ('lambda','class_definition') AND l.__start>f.body_start AND l.__start<a.__start AND l.__end>=a.__end))

stages.name: empty_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "condition_id",NULL AS "condition_start",NULL AS "condition_end",NULL AS "condition_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_source",NULL AS "callee_id","callee_kind",NULL AS "full_callee","callee","receiver","fn",NULL AS "symbol",NULL AS "serverplan" FROM (SELECT c.* FROM body_calls c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes arg WHERE arg.__path=c.__path AND arg.parent=c.arguments_id AND arg.kind!='comment'))

stages.name: eager_edges
stages.query: SELECT "__path","caller","target" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.fn caller,t.id target FROM body_calls c JOIN function_info owner ON owner.__path=c.__path AND owner.id=c.fn JOIN function_info t ON t.__path=c.__path AND t.name=c.callee JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute' AND receiver.kind='identifier' AND receiver.text='self' AND t.lexical_parent=owner.lexical_parent UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,t.id FROM body_calls c JOIN function_info t ON t.__path=c.__path AND t.name=c.callee AND t.lexical_parent IS NULL WHERE c.callee_kind='identifier')

stages.name: phases
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE phase(__path,fn,name) AS (SELECT __path,id,name FROM function_info WHERE name IN ('preprocess','lower','compile') UNION SELECT e.__path,e.target,p.name FROM phase p JOIN eager_edges e ON e.__path=p.__path AND e.caller=p.fn) SELECT * FROM phase)

stages.name: legacy_aliases
stages.query: SELECT "__path","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE alias(__path,name) AS (SELECT n.__path,h.name FROM nodes n CROSS JOIN (SELECT 'legacy_async' name UNION ALL SELECT 'legacy_module_async' name UNION ALL SELECT 'legacy_module_sync' name UNION ALL SELECT 'legacy_sync' name) h WHERE n.kind='module' UNION SELECT n.__path,n.alias_source FROM nodes n JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='aliased_import' AND parent.kind='import_from_statement' AND parent.module_name_source='l2050_transaction.legacy_wrappers' AND n.name_source IN ('legacy_async','legacy_module_async','legacy_module_sync','legacy_sync') UNION SELECT a.__path,b.name FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id JOIN alias old ON old.__path=a.__path AND old.name=a.expr_text WHERE a.fn IS NULL AND a.expr_kind='identifier') SELECT * FROM alias)

stages.name: legacy_functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id FROM function_info f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d JOIN legacy_aliases a ON a.__path=d.__path AND a.name=d.name WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM body_calls c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.fn=f.id AND c.full_callee IN ('_legacy_delegate_stub','_legacy_delegate_stub_async','_resolve_legacy_result_sync','_resolve_legacy_result_async','run_in_legacy_execution_boundary','run_in_legacy_execution_boundary_async')))

stages.name: indirect_targets
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","expression",NULL AS "fn","target" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id expression,c.fn,t.id target FROM body_calls c JOIN arguments first ON first.__path=c.__path AND first.call=c.id AND first.position=0 JOIN arguments second ON second.__path=c.__path AND second.call=c.id AND second.position=1 JOIN strings s ON s.__path=second.__path AND s.__start=second.__start JOIN function_info owner ON owner.__path=c.__path AND owner.id=c.fn JOIN function_info t ON t.__path=c.__path AND t.name=s.value AND t.lexical_parent=owner.lexical_parent WHERE c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee='getattr' AND first.kind='identifier' AND first.text='self'
        UNION SELECT c.__path,c.id,c.fn,t.id FROM body_calls c JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver JOIN arguments first ON first.__path=c.__path AND first.call=c.id AND first.position=0 JOIN strings s ON s.__path=first.__path AND s.__start=first.__start JOIN function_info owner ON owner.__path=c.__path AND owner.id=c.fn JOIN function_info t ON t.__path=c.__path AND t.name=s.value AND t.lexical_parent=owner.lexical_parent WHERE c.callee='__getattribute__' AND receiver.kind='identifier' AND receiver.text='self'
        UNION SELECT n.__path,n.id,o.fn,t.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=n.__path AND value.parent=n.id AND value.ordinal=0 JOIN calls c ON c.__path=value.__path AND c.id=value.id AND c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee='globals' JOIN nodes sub ON sub.__path=n.__path AND sub.parent=n.id AND sub.ordinal=1 JOIN strings s ON s.__path=sub.__path AND s.__start=sub.__start JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id JOIN function_info t ON t.__path=n.__path AND t.name=s.value AND t.lexical_parent IS NULL WHERE n.kind='subscript')

stages.name: legacy_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","name" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.fn,t.id,t.name FROM body_calls c JOIN eager_edges e ON e.__path=c.__path AND e.caller=c.fn JOIN function_info t ON t.__path=e.__path AND t.id=e.target AND t.name=c.callee JOIN legacy_functions legacy ON legacy.__path=t.__path AND legacy.id=t.id WHERE t.id!=c.fn UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,t.id,t.name FROM body_calls c JOIN indirect_targets indirect ON indirect.__path=c.__path AND indirect.expression=c.callee_id JOIN function_info t ON t.__path=indirect.__path AND t.id=indirect.target JOIN legacy_functions legacy ON legacy.__path=t.__path AND legacy.id=t.id WHERE t.id!=c.fn UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,t.id,t.name FROM body_calls c JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.fn=c.fn AND a.target_kind='identifier' AND a.target_text=c.callee JOIN indirect_targets indirect ON indirect.__path=a.__path AND indirect.expression=a.value JOIN function_info t ON t.__path=indirect.__path AND t.id=indirect.target JOIN legacy_functions legacy ON legacy.__path=t.__path AND legacy.id=t.id WHERE c.callee_kind='identifier' AND t.id!=c.fn)

stages.name: typed_parameters
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","name","type" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE annotation(__path,fn,name,id) AS (
        SELECT __path,fn,name,annotation FROM parameters WHERE annotation IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.name,n.id FROM annotation a JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.parent=a.id)
        SELECT DISTINCT a.__path,a.fn,a.name,n.text type FROM annotation a JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.id=a.id WHERE n.kind='identifier')

stages.name: scope_names
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","name" FROM (SELECT __path,fn,name FROM parameters WHERE name GLOB '*scope' UNION SELECT o.__path,o.fn,target.text FROM nodes pattern JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=pattern.__path AND value.parent=pattern.id AND value.ordinal=0 JOIN calls c ON c.__path=value.__path AND c.id=value.id JOIN nodes alias ON alias.__path=pattern.__path AND alias.parent=pattern.id AND alias.kind='as_pattern_target' JOIN nodes target ON target.__path=alias.__path AND target.parent=alias.id AND target.kind='identifier' JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=pattern.__path AND o.id=pattern.id WHERE pattern.kind='as_pattern' AND c.callee IN ('open_read_plan','open_write_plan'))

stages.name: scope_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id FROM empty_calls c LEFT JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver LEFT JOIN calls cast_call ON cast_call.__path=receiver.__path AND cast_call.id=receiver.id AND cast_call.callee='cast' LEFT JOIN arguments second ON second.__path=cast_call.__path AND second.call=cast_call.id AND second.position=1 AND second.kind='identifier' JOIN scope_names s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.fn=c.fn AND s.name=coalesce(second.text,CASE WHEN receiver.kind='identifier' THEN receiver.text END) WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee='execute')

stages.name: lazy_names
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","name",NULL AS "since" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE lazy(__path,fn,name,since) AS (
        SELECT __path,fn,name,-1 FROM typed_parameters WHERE type='LazyResult'
        UNION SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.target_text,a.__start FROM assignments a JOIN calls c ON c.__path=a.__path AND c.id=a.value WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND c.callee GLOB '*_lazy'
        UNION SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.target_text,a.__start FROM assignments a JOIN nodes annotation ON annotation.__path=a.__path AND annotation.id=a.type_id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.__start>=annotation.__start AND n.__end<=annotation.__end WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text='LazyResult'
        UNION SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.target_text,a.__start FROM assignments a JOIN lazy old ON old.__path=a.__path AND old.fn=a.fn AND old.name=a.expr_text AND old.since<a.__start WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND a.expr_kind='identifier') SELECT * FROM lazy)

stages.name: lazy_expressions
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","id" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE lazy(__path,fn,id) AS (
        SELECT n.__path,o.fn,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lazy_names l WHERE l.__path=n.__path AND l.fn=o.fn AND l.name=n.text)
        UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id FROM body_calls c WHERE c.callee GLOB '*_lazy'
        UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id FROM body_calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 JOIN lazy old ON old.__path=a.__path AND old.fn=c.fn AND old.id=a.id WHERE c.callee='cast') SELECT * FROM lazy)

stages.name: sql_expressions
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","id" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE sql_value(__path,fn,id) AS (
        SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id FROM body_calls c WHERE c.callee IN ('_resolve_lazy_in_external_boundary','_resolve_transaction_value_async') OR rx_matches(c.callee,'^(?:_find_|_get_|_list_)') AND c.callee NOT GLOB '*_lazy'
 UNION SELECT n.__path,o.fn,n.id FROM sql_value old JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=old.__path AND a.fn=old.fn AND a.value=old.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=a.target_text AND n.__start>a.__start JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id AND o.fn=a.fn WHERE a.target_kind='identifier'
 UNION SELECT n.__path,old.fn,n.id FROM sql_value old JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=old.__path AND child.id=old.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=child.__path AND n.id=child.parent WHERE n.kind IN ('attribute','await')) SELECT * FROM sql_value)

stages.name: raw_patterns
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "id","__start","__end","pattern","dirty","transitive" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'*.'||c.callee||'()' pattern,1 dirty,1 transitive FROM empty_calls c WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee IN ('resolve','resolve_async','result') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,c.callee||'()',1,1 FROM body_calls c WHERE c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('_resolve_legacy_result_async','_resolve_legacy_result_sync','resolve_lazy_param','resolve_lazy_param_str','resolve_server_value') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' THEN '*.' ELSE '' END||c.callee||'()',1,1 FROM body_calls c WHERE c.callee IN ('_append_revision_selector_filter','_effective_diff_to_revision','_safe_instance_dict','_safe_type_attr','deleted_ref_probe_helper','get_deleted_state_value','get_server_ref_id','peek_instance_attr','peek_resolved_value','preprocess_resolved_get') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' THEN '*.' ELSE '' END||c.callee||'()',1,0 FROM body_calls c WHERE c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('deleted_ref_value_helper') OR c.serverplan AND rx_matches(c.callee,'^(?:peek_)') UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.id,a.__start,a.__end,'*.'||a.attr,1,CASE WHEN a.attr IN ('_step_ref_id') OR a.attr='__dict__' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM body_attributes a WHERE a.attr IN ('__dict__','_deleted_state_slot','_ref_id','_step_ref_id','deleted_state_flag','deleted_state_value','is_resolved','resolved_value') AND (a.attr!='__dict__' OR a.serverplan) AND NOT (a.attr='deleted_state_value' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments x JOIN nodes annotation ON annotation.__path=x.__path AND annotation.id=x.type_id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=x.__path AND n.__start>=annotation.__start AND n.__end<=annotation.__end WHERE x.__path=a.__path AND x.fn=a.fn AND x.target_text=a.object_text AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text='PlanningServerValueShape')) UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' THEN '*.' ELSE '' END||c.callee||'('||s.value||')',1,CASE WHEN s.value IN ('_step_ref_id') OR s.value='__dict__' OR c.callee='getattr_static' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM body_calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start WHERE s.value IN ('__dict__','_deleted_state_slot','_ref_id','_step_ref_id','deleted_state_flag','deleted_state_value','is_resolved','resolved_value') AND (s.value!='__dict__' OR c.serverplan) AND (c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('getattr','hasattr') AND a.position=1 OR c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee='getattr_static' AND a.position=1 AND c.serverplan OR c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee='__getattribute__' AND a.position=(SELECT max(position) FROM arguments last WHERE last.__path=c.__path AND last.call=c.id)) UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'*.'||bound.attr||'<bound>',1,1 FROM body_calls c JOIN (SELECT __path,call,value FROM keywords UNION ALL SELECT __path,call,id FROM arguments) arg ON arg.__path=c.__path AND arg.call=c.id JOIN attributes bound ON bound.__path=arg.__path AND bound.id=arg.value WHERE bound.attr IN ('resolve','resolve_async') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'plan-scope:*.execute()',0,1 FROM body_calls c JOIN scope_calls s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.id=c.id UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'non-lazy-call:*.'||c.callee||'()',0,1 FROM body_calls c JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=c.__path AND root.expression=c.receiver WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee IN ('count','count_async','delete','delete_async','delete_by_id','delete_by_id_async','delete_by_key_many','delete_by_key_many_async','delete_many','delete_many_async','delete_many_returning','delete_many_returning_async','delete_returning','delete_returning_async','execute','execute_async','execute_one','execute_one_async','execute_raw','execute_raw_async','exists','exists_async','first','first_async','insert','insert_async','insert_many','insert_many_async','insert_many_raw','insert_many_raw_async','select_many','select_many_async','select_one','select_one_async','update','update_async','update_by_id','update_by_id_async','update_by_key','update_by_key_async','update_by_key_many','update_by_key_many_async','update_many','update_many_async','upsert','upsert_async','upsert_many','upsert_many_async','upsert_many_raw','upsert_many_raw_async') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scope_calls s WHERE s.__path=c.__path AND s.id=c.id) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.fn AND p.name=root.name AND (p.name IN stages.name: meaningful_statements
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","kind" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,n.id,n.__start,n.kind FROM function_info f JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=f.__path AND n.parent=f.body_id WHERE n.kind!='comment' AND NOT (n.kind='expression_statement' AND n.ordinal=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes v WHERE v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string'))))

stages.name: canonical_wrappers
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id",NULL AS "family" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,rx_replace(substr(lazy.full_callee,1,length(lazy.full_callee)-5),'^self\.','') family FROM function_info f JOIN meaningful_statements s ON s.__path=f.__path AND s.fn=f.id JOIN nodes stmt ON stmt.__path=s.__path AND stmt.id=s.id JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=stmt.__path AND value.parent=stmt.id AND value.ordinal=0 LEFT JOIN nodes awaited ON awaited.__path=value.__path AND awaited.parent=value.id AND value.kind='await' JOIN calls c ON c.__path=value.__path AND c.id=CASE WHEN rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') THEN awaited.id ELSE value.id END
        JOIN (SELECT __path,call,id value FROM arguments WHERE position=2 UNION ALL SELECT __path,call,value FROM keywords WHERE name='build_lazy') build ON build.__path=c.__path AND build.call=c.id JOIN nodes lambda ON lambda.__path=build.__path AND lambda.id=build.value AND lambda.kind='lambda' JOIN calls lazy ON lazy.__path=lambda.__path AND lazy.id=lambda.body_id
        WHERE s.kind IN ('return_statement','expression_statement') AND c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee=CASE WHEN rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') THEN '_resolve_legacy_result_async' ELSE '_resolve_legacy_result_sync' END AND lazy.callee GLOB '*_lazy' AND NOT rx_matches(lazy.full_callee,'[()]') AND (SELECT count(*) FROM meaningful_statements other WHERE other.__path=f.__path AND other.fn=f.id)=1 UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,rx_replace(substr(lazy.full_callee,1,length(lazy.full_callee)-5),'^self\.','') family
      FROM function_info f JOIN meaningful_statements s ON s.__path=f.__path AND s.fn=f.id
      JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=s.__path AND a.parent=s.id AND a.target_kind='identifier' AND a.type_start IS NULL
      JOIN calls lazy ON lazy.__path=a.__path AND lazy.id=a.value
      JOIN meaningful_statements r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.fn=f.id AND r.__start>s.__start AND r.kind='return_statement'
      JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=r.__path AND value.parent=r.id AND value.ordinal=0
      LEFT JOIN nodes awaited ON awaited.__path=value.__path AND awaited.parent=value.id AND value.kind='await'
      JOIN calls c ON c.__path=value.__path AND c.id=CASE WHEN rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') THEN awaited.id ELSE value.id END
      JOIN arguments arg ON arg.__path=c.__path AND arg.call=c.id AND arg.position=0
      JOIN attributes terminal ON terminal.__path=arg.__path AND terminal.id=arg.id
      JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=terminal.__path AND receiver.id=terminal.object AND receiver.kind='identifier' AND receiver.text=a.target_text
      WHERE lazy.callee GLOB '*_lazy' AND NOT rx_matches(lazy.full_callee,'[()]') AND c.callee_kind='identifier'
      AND c.callee=CASE WHEN rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') THEN 'run_in_legacy_execution_boundary_async' ELSE 'run_in_legacy_execution_boundary' END
      AND terminal.attr=CASE WHEN rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') THEN 'resolve_async' ELSE 'resolve' END
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM arguments x WHERE x.__path=c.__path AND x.call=c.id)=1
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM meaningful_statements other WHERE other.__path=f.__path AND other.fn=f.id)=2)

stages.name: seed_patterns
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","issue" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT r.__path,r.fn,'transitive:'||r.pattern issue FROM raw_patterns r JOIN function_info f ON f.__path=r.__path AND f.id=r.fn WHERE r.transitive AND NOT (r.pattern IN ('_resolve_legacy_result_sync()','_resolve_legacy_result_async()') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM canonical_wrappers w WHERE w.__path=r.__path AND w.id=r.fn)) AND NOT (f.symbol GLOB 'l2050_transaction.legacy_wrappers.*' OR f.symbol='l2070_batching.server_ref.deleted_planning_value_helper') AND NOT (r.pattern='*.resolve()' AND rx_matches(f.symbol,'^(?:impl\.common\.l2550_storage_backend\.local_backend\.|impl\.l1570_llm_client\.client\.LLMClient\._resolve_debug_dir|impl\.sqlite\.connection\.SyncSqliteConnection\.database_identity|l1000_schema\.path_validation\.|l1100_exceptions\.safe_file_ops\.|l8000_admin\.tools\.docs_search\.|l8000_admin\.tools\.validation\.|l8100_ops_analytics\.connection\.|l9600_graphs\.dynamic_vector\.resolve_dynamic_embedding_handler)')) AND NOT (r.pattern='*.result()' AND f.symbol IN ('impl.l1570_llm_client.client._run_sync','l5000_subscriptions.deferred_dispatch._run_async_callback_sync')) AND NOT (f.symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM approved_external) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND d.name IN ('external_io_boundary_eager_async')) AND (r.pattern GLOB 'non-lazy-call:*' OR r.pattern IN ('*.resolve()','*.resolve_async()','*.result()'))))

stages.name: transitive_patterns
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","issue","identity","symbol" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE dirty(__path,fn,issue) AS (SELECT * FROM seed_patterns UNION SELECT e.__path,e.caller,d.issue FROM dirty d JOIN eager_edges e ON e.__path=d.__path AND e.target=d.fn JOIN function_info f ON f.__path=e.__path AND f.id=e.caller WHERE f.symbol NOT GLOB 'l2050_transaction.legacy_wrappers.*' AND f.symbol!='l2070_batching.server_ref.deleted_planning_value_helper') SELECT f.__path,f.__start,f.__end,d.issue,f.id||':'||d.issue identity,f.symbol FROM dirty d JOIN function_info f ON f.__path=d.__path AND f.id=d.fn WHERE NOT(f.__path IN ('l2055_lazy_result/lazy_result.py','l2055_lazy_result/lazy_seq.py') AND (f.symbol IN ('l2055_lazy_result.lazy_result.NoneResultError.__init__') OR rx_matches(f.symbol,'^(?:l2055_lazy_result\.lazy_result\.LazyFieldRef\.|l2055_lazy_result\.lazy_result\.LazyResult\.|l2055_lazy_result\.lazy_seq\.LazySeq\.)'))) AND NOT(f.__path='l2070_batching/server_ref.py' AND d.issue IN ('transitive:*._deleted_state_slot','transitive:*._ref_id')) AND NOT(f.__path='l2070_batching/step.py' AND d.issue='transitive:*._ref_id' AND f.symbol GLOB 'l2070_batching.step.StepRef.*') AND NOT rx_matches(f.__path,'^conform/|(?:^|/)(?:tests|test_[^/]*)/') AND NOT rx_matches(f.__path,'(?:^|/)test_[^/]*$'))

stages.name: phase_patterns
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","issue","identity","symbol" FROM (SELECT r.__path,min(r.__start) __start,min(r.__end) __end,p.name||':'||r.pattern issue,r.fn||':'||p.name||':'||r.pattern identity,f.symbol FROM raw_patterns r JOIN phases p ON p.__path=r.__path AND p.fn=r.fn JOIN function_info f ON f.__path=r.__path AND f.id=r.fn WHERE r.dirty AND r.pattern NOT GLOB '_resolve_legacy_result_*' GROUP BY r.__path,r.fn,p.name,r.pattern)

stages.name: external_definitions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","issue","identity","symbol" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.__start,f.__end,'external-io-boundary:'||f.name||'()' issue,f.id identity,f.symbol FROM function_info f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND d.name IN ('external_io_boundary_eager_async')))

stages.name: preprocess_patterns
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","issue","identity","symbol" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.__start,c.__end,'preprocess:'||CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='identifier' THEN c.callee||'()' WHEN receiver.text='resolved' AND c.callee IN ('get','peek','resolve_server_ref') THEN 'resolved.'||c.callee||'()' ELSE '*.resolve(resolved)' END issue,c.id identity,f.symbol FROM body_calls c JOIN function_info f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.fn LEFT JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver WHERE f.name='preprocess' AND (c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('resolve_lazy_param','resolve_lazy_param_str','resolve_server_value') OR c.callee_kind='attribute' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.fn AND p.name='resolved' AND p.position>=1 AND p.kind!='typed_default_parameter') AND (receiver.kind='identifier' AND receiver.text='resolved' AND c.callee IN ('get','peek','resolve_server_ref') OR c.callee='resolve' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.kind='identifier' AND a.text='resolved'))))

stages.name: line_patterns
stages.query: SELECT "pattern","issue" FROM (SELECT '\.resolve\(\)' pattern,'.resolve()' issue UNION ALL SELECT '\.resolve_async\(\)' pattern,'.resolve_async()' issue UNION ALL SELECT '\.result\(\)' pattern,'.result()' issue UNION ALL SELECT '\bint\(\s*lazy' pattern,'int(lazy...)' issue UNION ALL SELECT '\bfloat\(\s*lazy' pattern,'float(lazy...)' issue UNION ALL SELECT '\bbool\(\s*lazy' pattern,'bool(lazy...)' issue)

stages.name: direct_sites
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "line","text","issue","symbol" FROM (SELECT l.*,p.issue,coalesce((SELECT f.symbol FROM function_info f WHERE f.__path=l.__path AND f.line<=l.line AND l.line<=f.line+length(f.text)-length(replace(f.text,char(10),'')) ORDER BY length(f.qualname)-length(replace(f.qualname,'.','')) DESC,length(f.text) LIMIT 1),replace(substr(l.__path,1,length(l.__path)-3),'/','.')||'::<module>') symbol FROM source_lines l CROSS JOIN line_patterns p WHERE rx_matches(l.text,p.pattern) AND NOT rx_matches(l.text,'^\s*#') AND NOT rx_matches(l.__path,'^conform/|(?:^|/)(?:tests|test_[^/]*)/') AND NOT rx_matches(l.__path,'(?:^|/)test_[^/]*$') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes s WHERE s.__path=l.__path AND s.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND s.line<=l.line AND l.line<=s.line+length(s.text)-length(replace(s.text,char(10),'')) AND instr(s.text,char(10))>0 AND NOT rx_matches(s.text,'^[rRuUbB]*[fF]')))

stages.name: direct_patterns
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","issue","identity","symbol" FROM (SELECT l.__path,l.__start,l.__end,l.issue,l.__start||':'||l.issue identity,l.symbol FROM direct_sites l WHERE NOT ((l.__path IN ('l2055_lazy_result/lazy_result.py','l2055_lazy_result/lazy_seq.py') AND (l.symbol IN ('l2055_lazy_result.lazy_result.NoneResultError.__init__') OR rx_matches(l.symbol,'^(?:l2055_lazy_result\.lazy_result\.LazyFieldRef\.|l2055_lazy_result\.lazy_result\.LazyResult\.|l2055_lazy_result\.lazy_seq\.LazySeq\.)')))
      OR (l.__path='l2070_batching/server_ref.py' AND l.issue IN ('transitive:*._deleted_state_slot','transitive:*._ref_id'))

      OR (l.__path='l2055_lazy_result/lazy_result.py' AND l.issue='.resolve()' AND l.symbol='l2055_lazy_result.lazy_result.LazyResult.result')
      OR (NOT rx_matches(l.__path,'^(?:impl/common/l2070_server_plan/|impl/common/l7300_sql_versioned_transactions/|l2050_transaction/|l2055_lazy_result/|l2070_batching/|l5100_fts/|l5200_vector_index/|l7200_versioned_transactions/)') AND (instr(l.issue,'__dict__')>0 OR instr(l.issue,'getattr_static(')>0 OR l.issue GLOB 'transitive:peek_*' OR l.issue GLOB 'peek_*'))
      OR (l.issue='.resolve()' AND rx_matches(l.symbol,'^(?:impl\.common\.l2550_storage_backend\.local_backend\.|impl\.l1570_llm_client\.client\.LLMClient\._resolve_debug_dir|impl\.sqlite\.connection\.SyncSqliteConnection\.database_identity|l1000_schema\.path_validation\.|l1100_exceptions\.safe_file_ops\.|l8000_admin\.tools\.docs_search\.|l8000_admin\.tools\.validation\.|l8100_ops_analytics\.connection\.|l9600_graphs\.dynamic_vector\.resolve_dynamic_embedding_handler)'))
      OR (l.issue='.result()' AND l.symbol IN ('impl.l1570_llm_client.client._run_sync','l5000_subscriptions.deferred_dispatch._run_async_callback_sync'))
      OR (l.symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM approved_external) AND (replace(l.issue,'transitive:','') IN ('*.resolve()','*.resolve_async()','*.result()','.resolve()','.resolve_async()','.result()') OR replace(l.issue,'transitive:','') GLOB 'non-lazy-call:*'))

query.default: SELECT d.__path path,d.__start start_byte,d.__end end_byte,d.issue,d.identity,d.symbol,rx_extract(value.unparse,'^[^\n]*',0) text FROM transitive_patterns d JOIN display_nodes selected ON selected.__path=d.__path AND selected.family='transitive_patterns' AND selected.identity=d.identity JOIN display_values value ON value.__path=selected.__path AND value.id=selected.id UNION ALL SELECT d.__path path,d.__start start_byte,d.__end end_byte,d.issue,d.identity,d.symbol,value.unparse text FROM phase_patterns d JOIN display_nodes selected ON selected.__path=d.__path AND selected.family='phase_patterns' AND selected.identity=d.identity JOIN display_values value ON value.__path=selected.__path AND value.id=selected.id UNION ALL SELECT d.__path path,d.__start start_byte,d.__end end_byte,d.issue,d.identity,d.symbol,rx_extract(value.unparse,'^[^\n]*',0) text FROM external_definitions d JOIN display_nodes selected ON selected.__path=d.__path AND selected.family='external_definitions' AND selected.identity=d.identity JOIN display_values value ON value.__path=selected.__path AND value.id=selected.id UNION ALL SELECT d.__path path,d.__start start_byte,d.__end end_byte,d.issue,d.identity,d.symbol,value.unparse text FROM preprocess_patterns d JOIN display_nodes selected ON selected.__path=d.__path AND selected.family='preprocess_patterns' AND selected.identity=d.identity JOIN display_values value ON value.__path=selected.__path AND value.id=selected.id UNION ALL SELECT d.__path path,d.__start start_byte,d.__end end_byte,d.issue,d.identity,d.symbol,trim(line.text) text FROM direct_patterns d JOIN direct_sites line ON line.__path=d.__path AND line.__start=d.__start AND line.issue=d.issue
